projectTitle: Sustainable Building Materials in Africa (2015–2025): A Systematic Evidence Synthesis of Material Classes, Technical Performance, and Implementation Contexts
author: Agbeniga Agboola

qualityAppraisal.primaryDeficit: Statistical variance reporting across replicate specimens (51.7% weighted compliance)

modules.purpose: Formal protocol documents detailing rationale, objectives, eligibility, databases, and synthesis strategy
Database query strings, hit counts (9,112), execution dates (2025-2026), and deduplication registers
Two-stage screening logs with explicit PRISMA exclusion codes and reproducible 10% re-screening audit log (kappa = 0.95), yielding 2,492 included primary empirical studies
Master 31-parameter extraction database (2,492 rows x 31 columns) across 5 material classes
Design-stratified critical appraisal records across 5 study designs using JBI and ISO 14040/44 frameworks
8 synthesis tables (Geography, Taxonomy, Benchmarks 3A-D, LCA, Quality, Barriers) and 5 publication figures
Full APA 7th Edition manuscript (10,782 words, 10 tables, 54 references, Appendix 1), cover letter, and JOBE guidelines
PRISMA 2020 item-by-item checklists, flow diagrams, and supplementary search appendix
